chars.INFLUENCER: a Moroccan man around 30 with a trimmed black beard and slicked-back hair, wearing a cream oversized hoodie with a thin gold chain, black ripped jeans and white sneakers
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of 19 with long dark wavy hair, wearing a lilac zip-up tracksuit jacket over a white top and light blue wide-leg jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: INFLUENCER stands in his small content studio with ring lights and a camera on a tripod, holding his phone to his ear and smiling slyly while talking, seen from the studio doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits on her bed in her bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, staring at her phone screen with wide excited eyes, a hand over her mouth, seen from the bedroom door

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: INFLUENCER and GIRL sit across a small table in a modern Casablanca cafe, he leans forward explaining something with his hands while she listens curiously

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the evening, GIRL in her bedroom answers a phone call, surprised, warm lamp light, window showing a dusk sky over Moroccan rooftops

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: INFLUENCER in his dim studio, phone to his ear, beckoning with his free hand toward the viewer with a confident grin, ring light behind him

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of INFLUENCER holding his phone and pressing a finger to his lips in a 'keep it secret' gesture, raised eyebrows, studio background

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits on the edge of her bed holding her phone in her lap, biting her lip, hesitant and uneasy, looking toward the window

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GIRL walks happily along a Moroccan city street toward the glass entrance door of a building, holding her phone, smiling with excitement, daytime

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: GIRL stands in a street smiling dreamily, imagining herself famous: around her floating glowing social media like and heart icons, a big blank billboard behind her, no letters anywhere
